segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I have you down for 24 standard seats, 3 admin seats, and a target go-live of May 6. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add two more service managers in June, but I don't want to buy those seats today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fine. The order can start with 27 total seats, and any added seats later are prorated to the same March 31 renewal date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the number you sent was $36,480 annually, plus $4,200 for onboarding?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. That includes the calibration workflow module, asset import, and two training sessions. Taxes are not included, and billing is net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 works. Our AP team needs the PO number on the invoice. It'll be PO-77419.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, PO-77419. I'll include that on the order form and billing setup. For onboarding, we have Tuesday and Thursday afternoons open the week of April 15.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's do Tuesday the 16th at 2 Central for the kickoff. Our quality lead, Marissa, should be included.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll list Marissa as the quality lead and put the kickoff for April 16 at 2 Central. The first training would then be April 23, same time, if that works.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. Send the order form to me and copy procurement. If legal doesn't redline the limitation language, I can sign this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the order form today with the seat count, PO, renewal date, and onboarding dates in it. Anything else you want reflected before I send it?
